name: kxcbdecisioncanada
title: Bank of Canada decision in Oct 2026?
settlement: This market resolves based on the Bank of Canada's official interest rate decision announced at its October 28, 2026 policy meeting. It resolves Yes for the specific bracket (e.g., Hike 25bps) that matches the actual change to the Bank's target overnight rate announced that day, as published in the Bank of Canada's official policy statement.
decideContext: You are estimating the magnitude and direction (in basis points) of the Bank of Canada's policy rate change at the Oct 28, 2026 meeting (hike, hold, or cut, and by how much), which determines which of the five brackets resolves Yes.
